messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nCustomers are uncertain whether their Keelwater pricing plans include integrations with repair networks and unlimited document uploads. This confusion delays their purchasing decisions and risks them either underutilizing available features or overpaying for them.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Two accounts have raised this issue via the sales route [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].\n- The affected accounts are Pendleford Motor Mutual and Wexmoor Motor [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].\n\n## Evidence\n- There are 2 accounts with a total ARR of £2,640,000.0 [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual, with an ARR of £690,000.0, asked for confirmation on whether the enterprise plan includes unlimited integrations with garage systems [i:7b19a715e7ab161d].\n- Wexmoor Motor, with an ARR of £1,950,000.0, requested clarification on how pricing tiers handle third-party repair network integrations and confirmation that the annual license fee includes unlimited document uploads and supplier integrations [i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].\n- The issue has been mentioned 2 times, all through the sales route [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].\n\n## Why now\n- Both inquiries were made on 2026-10-26 [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual's renewal date is 2027-02-28 [i:7b19a715e7ab161d].\n- Wexmoor Motor's renewal date is 2027-06-30 [i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].\n- No renewals have occurred in the last 90 days, indicating these are active, pre-renewal accounts seeking clarity on their current or future contracts [i:7b19a715e7ab161d][i:ac36fe84a9a375e5].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "7b19a715e7ab161d",
   "quote": "Just confirming — does enterprise include unlimited integrations with garage systems?",
   "account": "Pendleford Motor Mutual",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-26T09:40:00Z"
  },
  {
   "id": "ac36fe84a9a375e5",
   "quote": "Yes, please — and while we’re at it, can you clarify how the pricing tiers handle integrations with third-party repair networks? Just to confirm, the annual license fee still includes unlimited document uploads and supplier integrations, right?",
   "account": "Wexmoor Motor",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-26T11:03:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 2,
  "mentions_n": 2,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 2
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 2640000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Pendleford Motor Mutual",
    "arr_gbp": 690000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-02-28",
    "mentions": 1
   },
   {
    "name": "Wexmoor Motor",
    "arr_gbp": 1950000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-06-30",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the account names, ARR figures, mention counts, routes, dates, and renewal details against the fact sheet and cited insights. The two accounts (Pendleford Motor Mutual £690,000; Wexmoor Motor £1,950,000) sum to the stated £2,640,000 total, both insights are dated 2026-10-26 via the sales route matching the 2 mentions/1 route counts, and renewal dates (2027-02-28 and 2027-06-30) match the fact sheet. The paraphrased account requests accurately reflect the cited quotes without placing paraphrases in quotation marks, and the claim of no renewals in the last 90 days matches renewals_90d_n of 0. No uncited, overstated, or contrary claims were found.", "verdict": "pass"}
